tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rdo rje gur rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor cho ga'i mdun bskyed kyi ngag 'don gyi gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// bde chen snying po 'dzin pa'i grong khyer mchog /skal bzang smin par byed pa'i yon tan mdzod// slob dpon rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag bgyis nas// mkha' 'byin cho ga'i gsal byed cung zad bri// 'dir rdo rje gur mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i mdun bskyed skabs su/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis nam mkha'i dbyings su sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i pam̐ pad+ma sogs nas/ kha dog lnga 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos kyi 'byung gnas phyogs kun nas gru gsum pa sogs nas 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang par gyur/ gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad ces pa nas ro'i gdan re re zhes pa'i bar sta gon ltar brjod/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma sogs nas/ ku ru ṣ+wa me yab yum thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa sgyu ma bde ba'i sgra dang*/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las thig le cha bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gyur/ de rnams mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ shar du phan pa/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma/

nub tu pad+ma gar dbang*/ byang du rta'i rgyal po rnams rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai ta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha wa rī/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du skam pa ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu dol zlum ma/ byang du lcags kyu ma/ byang shar du me tog ma/ shar lhor bdug spos ma/ lho nub tu mar me ma/ nub byang du byug pa ma/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du nyi lag ma/ lhor mar me ma/ nub tu rin chen skar mda' ma/ byang du glog lag ma/ byang shar du sgeg mo/ shar lhor bzhad pa mo/ lho nub tu glu ma/ nub byang du gar ma/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du pad+ma ma/ lhor chos 'byung ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du 'khyud ma/ byang shar du gling bu ma/ shar lhor pi wang ma/ lho nub tu rnga zlum ma/ nub byang du rdza rnga ma/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du sgo lcags ma/ lhor lde kyog ma/ nub tu sgo glegs ma/ byang du gos 'dzin ma/ byang shar du spyan ma/ shar lhor mā ma kī/ lho nub tu gos dkar mo/ nub byang du sgrol ma/ de rnams kyi phyi'i shar du lcags kyu ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du dril bu ma rnams zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can du gyur/ de rnams yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te dkyil 'khor so so'i gdan rnams kyi steng du 'khod pa ni/

dkyil chog gzhung du/ dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ shar du rtag pa/ lhor rin chen rgyal po/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du rta'i rgyal po ste thams cad kyang zhal brgyad pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dbang po sngon po lta bu'i rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba zhes pa'i bar 'dra bar brjod/ gzhan bzhi la'ang de'i rigs 'gre sbyar ba ltar bshad pas de bzhin byas kyang chog mod/ dkyus ma 'di bzhin byas na legs che/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog dbang po sngon po lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che sogs nas 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan cing yum mā ma kī sngon mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rtag pa sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na rma bya sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin chen rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser/ g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na bya ka ran+da sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rta mgrin sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na dom sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba/ rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rta mchog sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang ba/

zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal rta'i gdong pa can ljang gu/ g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba/ thams cad kyi steng zhal dud ka rgyab zhal bzhi gnag pa sogs nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs ltar brjod/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la gau rī dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa sogs nas rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la skam pa ma dkar mo sogs nas dung chos 'dzin pa/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la nyi lag ma dkar mo sogs nas gar gyi tshul byed pa/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la pad+ma ma dkar mo sogs nas rdza rnga 'dzin pa/ rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la sgo lcags ma dkar mo sogs nas ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ phyi'i shar sgor lcags kyu ma sogs nas dril bu 'dzin pa/ de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma sogs nas bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod do// de nas dngos gzhi nyi ma dang po'i tshe rdo rje gsor zhing dha ra dha ra sogs lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad la/ oṃ bha ga wān sogs kyis chu bzhi phul te dgug gzhug bya/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa nas de'i tshab tu/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ chu bzhis mchod de dgug gzhug gong ltar dang yan lag lhag ma gnyis byas pas grub bo// gzhan rnams ni go bar sla'o// rigs bsdus lha yi 'khor lo mkha' sgo nas// 'byin pa'i ngag 'don gsal byed bgyis pa yi// dge bas sems can thams cad thar pa'i grong*// bde chen bdud rtsi'i ro la rtsen gyur cig

/ces rdo rje gur rigs bsdus dkyil 'khor cho ga'i mdun bskyed kyi ngag 'don gyi gsal byed 'di ni dbu mdzad phun tshogs dar rgyas pa'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis ldan yul chos sder bris pa maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa la nye bar mkho ba'i tho chung bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal he ru ka gnyis su med pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i tho chung cung zad 'god pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab rnams na shin tu gsal bar bzhugs kyang*/ sgrub mchod kyi skabs su rgyas pa 'di kho na 'don pa phyag len shin tu legs shing*/ 'on kyang sgrub mchod gzhan dang bstun dgos pa sogs kyi skabs 'gar/ tshig tshogs cung zad bsdu dgos pa byung ba'i tshe/ phyi'i he ru ka gsal gdab pa'i skabs kyi dag pa rnams dor ba dang*/ byang chub phyogs kyi dag pa rgyas pa bzhag nas/ bsdus pa tsam brjod pas rung zhing*/ de'i khyad par rnams dkyus su gsal ba yod na'ang*/ 'dir yang zur du bkol te cung zad cig brjod na/ dur khrod gsal gdab pa yan chad dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ de nas/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru dang*/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug

drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa bsgreng pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs lus dkyil ma gtogs par gdan sngar nas gsal btab zin pa rnams la pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na zhes pa ma brjod kyang chog g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bus spras shing*/ g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang*/ mtshog ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan nang dkyil sogs lha bskyed thams cad kyi skabs su 'di brjod na legs/ drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug gis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud cing gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal dang rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā mā ljang gu nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig spyan gsum ma/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/

skra grol ba sogs dkyus ltar brjod/ lam la som nyi spong ba sogs kyi skabs nas/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o zhes pa nas/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa nas mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o zhes pa'i bar dor la/ de'i tshab du bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha sum cu so bdun po 'di nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang lha sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no zhes mdor bsdus nas brjod pas rung ste 'di la yang phar dag tshur dag gnyis ka tshang ngo*// zhes pa'i 'di ni bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i bla ma dam pa nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi gsung don bzhin ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis tho tsam du bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
